protocol.prompt: 赤いキューブだけを掴んで持ち上げて。そのまま保持して。横へ運んだり、置いたりしないで。
protocol.fixed_action_source: grip_only_query.response.txt; existing Gemini detection, central red cube; verified again in repeat_setup_ready.jpg
protocol.scope_exclusion: No conversational planning repeated per trial. Measures existing closed-loop pick and hold verification only.
protocol.scope: Pick up red cube; photograph and judge hold; put back at original area; judge empty jaws; park.
protocol.excluded: All previous exploratory transport and single-grasp observations.
stop_rules: No hardware/API reconnect or automatic actuator retries.
Abort on communication error, invalid action/target, put-back failure.
Stop after two consecutive pick failures.
protocol.labels: Sensor result and independent assistant review of saved images; not author human labels.
limitations: Same object and nominal location; not independent task samples.
Pick target hint frozen from prior Gemini detection; per-trial Gemini planning not evaluated.
Printed sheet physically present; algorithm uses markerless mode.
Per-request verification costs only; tracking total not available.

成功
グリッパのオレンジ色のフィンガーと黒色のフィンガーの間に、赤いキューブがしっかりと挟まれて保持されているのが確認できます。

limits: Single red cube, same nominal area; five repetitions are not five independent tasks.
Fixed existing Gemini pick hint, no per-trial natural-language planning.
Assistant labels are not independent human annotation.
Costs cover only the ten hold/empty verification requests for each model.
No complete tracking cost, no externally measured position accuracy.
Earlier transport pilots, single pick pilot, and no-action query are excluded.
